findings.printed: Additional +2 to ordinary successful Aid Another +2 -> total +4
findings.current: Raw catalog text +5 instead of +2; overlay modifier value 5 targeting aidAnother.droid.sameRemoteProcessor
findings.fixBoundary: Requires rules-aware Aid Another bonus derivation; do not merely change a +5 static modifier to +4 without checking for base +2 duplication.

findings.printed: -500 credits reduces cost of constructing a remotely processed droid
findings.current: computeDroidPartCost clamps resolved prices to Math.max(0, ...), so a negative cost source cannot yield a construction discount
findings.fixBoundary: Implement correctly bounded construction cost offset with external processor eligibility; do not permit negative cash-back purchase in Garage.

findings.component: Remote Receiver / Backup Processor / Synchronized Fire Circuits
findings.printed: Remote processor exists outside droid, receiver fitted only when no internal processor; backup/synchronized require the receiver and shared controller as appropriate
findings.current: Overlay prerequisiteIds ['remote-processor','remote-receiver'] for backup/circuits; raw catalog's receiver requiredSystems ['remote']
findings.fixBoundary: Do not require a physically installed external transmitter on same actor; model remote-controller link while respecting receiver and exclusivity.
Treat dash as not listed rather than source proof of 0 kg.
Flag unsupported source weight; no silent rewriting before migration.

findings.printed: Attach/remove full-round DC10 Mechanics; heuristic self-removal standard DC20 Charisma + DC15 Mechanics; retry lockout 24h if Charisma fails
findings.current: Raw description/notes include aspects but mechanical consumer verification not conducted
findings.fixBoundary: Add explicit actor state/owner/droid-caller and action-economy acceptance fixtures.

findings.current: Raw droid systems communications entry could be offered among installed parts
findings.fixBoundary: Equipment or external controller classification, not installedSystems component on target droid.

findings.printed: Standard if droid can speak languages other than Binary
findings.current: Catalog charges 50 credits; actual factory inclusion or builder credit logic not tested
findings.fixBoundary: Allow legitimate factory-grant and separate purchased installation states; no double debit.

findings.printed: Darkness concealment only; improved low-light does not ignore total concealment, darkvision does
findings.current: Raw descriptive fields and some overlay senses exist, actual visibility/combat engine not tested
findings.fixBoundary: Verify precise low-light/darkness/total concealment tests in Foundry, not a blanket detection bonus.

guardrails: Do not equate printed presence with a mechanically certified installed part.
Negative Remote Receiver price is a droid-construction cost adjustment; never issue uncapped refund.
A droid caller is handheld, not an installed droid body part.
No full 92-KEEP census claim; this is a separate source-fact batch.
